personal_statement: I am a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with experience designing, implementing and evaluating applied ML systems across fraud detection, financial risk, graph learning and engineering applications. I combine strong software engineering discipline with advanced machine learning expertise, including graph-based feature extraction, time-series modelling, probabilistic deep learning and scalable benchmarking. With a proven track record of delivering production-relevant ML work on large-scale transaction data, I bring both research depth and production focus to drive technical decisions.
